changes: Finite static recipes instead of dynamic StyleX
Stone H1–H6 headings use font weight 400 instead of the upstream 600/700 weights, including frontend, rich text and editor previews.
Neutral/Ocean retain the existing 17px editorial body scale; Stone follows the upstream 14px body scale.
Figtree is bundled for body text; Stone additionally bundles Montserrat headings and JetBrains Mono code under SIL OFL 1.1.

Native details/summary accordions: Single uses separate compact cards with 8px gaps after the CollapsibleGroup v0.6.8 overview; Multiple retains the Collapsible overview's shared card with 16px gaps. Both animate disclosure and preserve native grouping without JavaScript.
Ocean derived from verified blue/cyan tokens
Neutral/Ocean destructive buttons pair dark red with white in light mode and pale red with dark text in dark mode; Stone retains its upstream categorical red pair.
CSS attribute bridge reapplies complete theme tokens at each nested boundary

Hero image-only contract; 54% transparent white panels with black foregrounds protect overlay content and normal-flow image captions in every theme/mode; Textmedia supports standard controlled media and poster
Shared image display aspect presets retain the default FAL crop variant
Original small SVG icon set and portable, locally bundled fonts.

Carousel uses 8px dots inspired by the Pagination v0.6.6 reference, native scroll-snap with unique reachable page positions, larger touch targets and six editor-selectable positions (including top placement)

Subpages use native Fluid SideNav links matching the v0.6.7 reference typography and Neutral hover/selected colors, without icons/sections; container width replaces fixed sidebar width and long labels wrap.

Sitemap adapts TreeList v0.6.7 with native linked lists, vertical guides, 16px indentation, 24px-wide disclosure targets and an ARIA tree enhanced with roving focus, arrow keys and type-ahead. Enter follows links and Space toggles branches; the complete hierarchy remains linked without JavaScript.

Stone follows the v0.6.7 theme preview and CLI template: exact heading/body/supporting scale, light/dark semantic/categorical/syntax colors, pill Button variants, pastel Badge/Notice variants and Card surfaces/padding. Fluid size=medium follows the semantic heading level; small maps to h3, large to h1 and display to display2. Notice is the native editorial adaptation of Banner. TYPO3 page layouts and editorial structure remain extension-owned.

Header navigation visually adapts DropdownMenu v0.6.8 with native Fluid links/disclosures, 4px panel padding, 32px desktop rows, content-sized independent flyouts, hover/arrow navigation and edge flipping. Mobile retains in-flow 44px disclosures; no action-menu semantics or React runtime.
